newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Seoul stocks seen moving narrowly in consolidation.
newsitem.headline: Seoul stocks seen moving narrowly in consolidation.

text.p: Seoul stocks were forecast to move in narrow ranges on Wednesday as securities and other large-cap shares would remain weaken on consolidation, brokers said.
On Tuesday the composite index fell 5.18 points to 769.83.
Trading in large-cap stocks would also be affected by concerns about possible heavy institutional selling or buying ahead of Thursday's settlement of June index futures contracts.
"Investors are expected to shun large-cap stocks, especially those included in the KOSPI-200 index, until tomorrow," said Park Byung-moon, head of research at LG Securities.

The Securities Supervisory Board on Monday said it was concerned that increasing open interest for arbitrage trading between spot and futures trading would create volatility on the June settlement date.
The current situation recalled a plunge in share prices on December 12, the settlement date for December futures contracts, due to massive selling of shares for arbitrage trading.
